wald_log_a.param: log a_s, season intercepts with common slope (equivalently log b/a_s)

wald_sep_log_ba.param: log b_s/a_s, separate season fits, rng [SEED,40] (sensitivity)

test.contrast: 3 adjacent season differences; the Wald statistic is invariant to the contrast basis
test.mdd_definition: f = sqrt(lambda/W), lambda the noncentrality giving power 0.8 for a level-0.05 chi-square(3) test; mdd_max_over_min_a = exp(f * range of log a_s deviations from their inverse-variance weighted mean)

validation.score: mean L/mu + log mu on held-out rows; positive power-minus-affine favours affine
